narration.text: Voucher payments kept coming: inspections cured, tenant damage reported, rent increases asked for on time. This is a chore for the managing member of a small LLC that owns five apartments on two lots, four of them leased to families with Housing Choice Vouchers. Athena works it across 4 portals: Landlord Link, Rentroll, Repairly and Ledgerline. On the bench, she found 9 of 9 eligible items, worth 4,970 dollars of the 4,970 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 13 traps, and she walked past 13. Among them: Work orders for a fan and a range already replaced, and for a unit that passed. Certifying a GFCI, a latch or a smoke alarm that is not fixed yet. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 35 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
